issues.detail: reports/w3-local-ci.log reflects a pre-fix recipe (no catch2 tool_requires). The fixed recipe is verified by reports/conan-create.log: catch2/2.13.10-r0 resolved via tool_requires, 'All tests passed (45 assertions in 4 test cases)'. Recommendation: regenerate W3 log with the fixed recipe.

notes.md line 47 states conandata keeps 'official URL first + mirror fallback', but conandata.yml contains only the single official URL (correct per P1-1; mirror fallback exists only at download-cache level).
conandata uses singular scalar url: while CI pre-download parser expects a list; does not affect conan create (official URL + verified sha256).

summary: 复核通过 (PASS)。P1-1 已修复：conandata.yml sources.url 为官方 HTTPS 单 URL + sha256，无 file:// 本地路径。P1-2 已修复：build_requirements() tool_requires('catch2/2.13.10-r0')，_run_upstream_tests() 从 dependencies.build['catch2'].cpp_info.includedirs 取 include，Catch2 不可解析时 raise ConanException (R9)。R34 空壳检测通过（真实调用 tl::generator + 断言 + 非零退出码）。W2 原子性通过。R39/R37/R38/R26/R32 合规。仅剩 3 条 P3 非阻塞提示。
